system.name: PFGNAS
system.one_liner: An LLM proposes GNN architectures per client in personalized federated learning; a weight-sharing supernet on each client limits client drift.

content.variant_note: an LLM controller, a server and clients exchange four colour-coded message types; prompt cards above and a supernet beside the clients complete the loop
content.argues: An LLM controller, driven by four prompt parts and refined by client performance fed back into the prompt, can steer personalized per-client GNN architectures over federated rounds.
content.subject: LLM-driven architecture search loop across a server and clients holding pruned supernets, with four message types

lessons.what_to_learn: Show an LLM's prompt as a band of numbered, titled grey cards with coloured slots above the system, and let the feedback arrow climb back into the last card so the loop closes without extra boxes. A legend strip of coloured sample arrows names each message type.
lessons.suits: Client-server or LLM-in-the-loop methods where several prompt parts, a hub and per-client models must share one frame, and where messages differ by kind.

evidence: The framework optimal the parameters of GNAS and supernet through four communication processes.
Each client acquires a personalized model by pruning the supernet and begins to train the model in a federated way.
We design prompts that combine the search task, search space, strategy, and historical performance

summary: PFGNAS lets an LLM act as a controller that proposes graph neural network architectures for each client in personalized federated learning, while a weight-shared supernet on every client limits client drift. Figure 1 draws the whole loop in one frame: four grey prompt cards (search task, search space, search strategy, performance feedback) with coloured slots sit above a dashed divider. Below, an LLM controller box with three vendor logos outputs a list of per-client architectures, which a cloud-server icon exchanges with the clients through four colour-coded block arrows. On the right a supernet with dashed red and blue arcs is pruned into a client model. A numbered legend strip names the four message types.
summary_zh: PFGNAS 让大语言模型为个性化联邦学习中的每个客户端生成图神经网络架构，并用权重共享的超网缓解客户端漂移。图中四张提示词卡片位于上方，下方是 LLM 控制器、服务器与客户端，四色箭头对应四种通信，右侧超网被剪枝成客户端子模型。
notes: Prior kinds kept. The figure is also a closed loop (arrow 4 climbs into prompt card 4), though the legend says the performance goes to the server. The two grey arrows into the server are unlabelled, the third LLM logo (blue elephant) is not identifiable, and the teal chevron icons and the dashed arcs are not explained in the figure or caption.
